summary: תַּרְשִׁישׁ is a precious stone, set in the high priest’s breastpiece and named in descriptions of splendid ornament; the Septuagint’s χρυσόλιθος links it to the seventh foundation stone of Rev 21:20.

senses.definition: The name of a precious stone used in the high priest's breastpiece and in descriptions of splendid ornament.

evidence.note: The seventh foundation stone is called χρυσόλιθος.

note:
The stone shares its spelling with the port Tarshish and the name borne by three people, all now in names/ttarexiyx (the place word, w.bq.ay, moved there). The mineral’s identification and a possible connection with the place through trade remain uncertain.

Root (2026-11-21): A quadriliteral with no verbal root in Hebrew or the cognates; the stone likely takes its name from the place Tarshish, so the noun keeps its own consonants.
